=> < deviceA | 'key' : Kdevice , ... > $ deviceA 'bindDevice' cloudA | (Kdevice ; Kuser) .
[B2] < cloudA | deviceA : ('key' : Kdevice , 'owner' : nils , ...) , UserY : ('key' : Kuser , ...) , ... > $ deviceA 'bindDevice' cloudA | (Kdevice ; Kuser)
